Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that uses an agent-based model to simulate land transactions between farmers and nature-conservation organizations under global change scenarios in a case study area in the province of Gelderland, Netherlands. While it involves future land-use change, it fails multiple core inclusion criteria: (1) it is explicitly regional/local in scale (~300 km²), not national; (2) its primary objective is evaluating feasibility of ecological network implementation under policy and economic constraints, not LULC prediction per se; (3) although two future scenarios are used, the focus is on land acquisition dynamics and budget/willingness-to-pay constraints rather than spatial LULC projection; (4) no quantitative accuracy metrics for LULC predictions are reported (e.g., validation against observed data, confusion matrices, etc.); and (5) outputs emphasize cumulative area purchased and spatial fragmentation, not mapped LULC projections as such. Additionally, it meets exclusion criteria: local/regional scale focus and ecological/restoration focus rather than LULC prediction as the central aim.)
